installationAdmission.creatorDefaultCommandSemantics: For every actual creator, global FOR ROLE creator REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS FROM PUBLIC; per-schema-only REVOKE cannot undo global defaults. Exact scoped table/sequence grants only at object creation, none emitted here.

installationAdmission.oracleEvidence: Every oracle records actual database/engine/version, observer and effective nonowner caller, creator, exact artifact/consumer/metadata/lock/output heads and hashes, setup variant, SQLSTATE/request result and before/after scoped + unrelated snapshots, with no secrets.
positiveControls: Qualified same-tenant valid permit succeeds only through existing Hasura legacy funnel and consumes once; ordinary legacy behavior and editor_sync mirrors preserved.
Exact nonowner guard can lock needed link/document rows and consume only three permitted columns; no extra writes.
Each actual creator creates a probe with scoped explicit rights and no effective PUBLIC EXECUTE or broad table/sequence defaults.
Future complete generated activation closes real owner-write, worker and Hasura-connection contexts with tenant isolation; this slice supplies no activation proof.

oracles.evidence: Missing-field disposition and unchanged before/after catalog + metadata snapshot.
oracles.given: At least one exact target, caller, guard owner, creator or staging input is absent or mismatches catalog readback.
oracles.then: Refuse before any DDL/ACL/metadata write; do not skip grants, infer identity, or provision a principal.
oracles.when: Attempt installation admission, including an absent connection on a fresh chain.

oracles.evidence: pg_roles, pg_auth_members recursive closure/options, pg_proc/pg_class owners and denied SET ROLE result.
oracles.given: Owner has LOGIN, SUPERUSER, BYPASSRLS, CREATEDB, CREATEROLE or REPLICATION; owns a data table; or product caller can transitively assume/inherit/administer it.
oracles.then: Refuse before changes; application SET ROLE owner is denied; owner is a nonowner for guard data relations.
oracles.when: Attempt owner-contract admission for each individual defect and direct/transitive membership option.

oracles.evidence: proconfig/definition hashes, effective schema ACL/membership and denied CREATE outcome; no secrets.
oracles.given: One guard lacks fixed pg_catalog,public,editor search_path or an untrusted caller retains CREATE on a searched schema.
oracles.then: Reject unsafe definition/ACL; no successful shadowed helper or altered permit disposition.
oracles.when: Attempt admission; exercise same-name helper shadowing under untrusted nonowner.

oracles.evidence: Actual mapped nonowner identity, SQLSTATE (42501 for ACL absence), RLS flags/policies and unchanged row/permit snapshots.
oracles.given: Actual nonowner guard has exact SELECT closure but lacks UPDATE(qnr_id) on sync_links or UPDATE(id) on collab_documents, or lacks schema USAGE, or RLS denies its required lookup.
oracles.then: Permission/lookup failure prevents the guarded write and permit consumption atomically; never compensate with table-wide UPDATE or ownership.
oracles.when: Invoke each pinned guard through its real trigger path under each missing right.

oracles.evidence: Effective column/table/helper ACL closure and denied operations under nonowner; unchanged ledgers.
oracles.given: Guard owner has exact positive closure on every guard/helper dependency.
oracles.then: All excess access denied; only enumerated SELECT, locking UPDATE and three consumption UPDATE columns remain effective.
oracles.when: Attempt permit INSERT/DELETE, UPDATE revoked_at or non-consumption columns, forbidden table writes and unrelated function calls.

oracles.then: Admission rejects effective excess EXECUTE; denied ordinary helper call leaves permit/write state unchanged. Product callers receive no CREATE/TRIGGER bootstrap rights.
oracles.when: Attempt installation admission and invoke helpers as ordinary callers without an explicit allowed helper right.

oracles.then: Reject missing/inconsistent defaults; no PUBLIC EXECUTE on newly created functions, no broad application table/sequence grants. Creator inheritance never substitutes for current_role defaults.

oracles.then: Whole transaction rolls back: no object exposure window, stale PUBLIC EXECUTE or surviving temporary CREATE; prior scoped and unrelated objects/ACLs unchanged.
oracles.when: Inject a failure after each owner/default/ACL/trigger stage, including after temporary CREATE for ALTER OWNER.

checks: Eligible unread same-tenant v2-linked row: returns only id,customer_id; omit or enlarge request limit and still return at most one row
Same otherwise eligible row already present in queries_read for verified session user: absent; other user's marker does not replace the current user's unread predicate
Foreign tenant, foreign link customer, unlinked or legacy-mastered row: no returned row or protected identifiers; repeat with matching/adversarial activity, customer_id and patient selectors
Authenticated caller with no queries SELECT and no inherited SELECT: function root unavailable/validation denied; it must not gain read access from function tracking or EXECUTE alone
Missing tenant session field: denied with no rows or protected data; valid tenant A session with body/function customer_id B cannot claim B
Request properties or any column/relationship outside declared envelope, or function aggregation root: validation denied; result type exposes only intended columns
hasura_session is absent from client function args; tenant/role/user arrive from server session and actual hasura.user equality/presence is proved without printing permit values
Function is absent from mutation schema and has no new write rights; repeat envelope checks for any exposed subscription read root
actualHasuraReadback.connection: Exact existing Hasura PG login: nonowner of function and returned table, nonsuperuser/non-BYPASSRLS; verify inherited/SET ROLE paths too. Hasura role is internal qnr_projection_writer, not admin.

legacyFunctionReadSurfaceContract.readbackSql: rbac/asma8350/readback.sql; exact-signature owner/volatility/return/ACL/EXECUTE evidence, no grants
